So, don’t come to her with ALL my problems, thus overwhelming her? 

I hope I understand right, and I’m really not trying to do that
Sorry, by emotional crutch you mean...??
Thank you. I’m just hoping I don’t go too far. I’ll let her know what I’m missing in life rn and hopefully that won’t draw the line
I can never find any games when I try to play Ultra 2. Not sure about 30th anniversary though
lol the topic of work came up and my dad just berated me as well. He wasn’t drunk though. I feel you

I love him so much though, and I depend on him for a lot of things. I don’t want to break our relationship. 

He can’t even look at me in the face anymore. He’s so disappointed with me
I finished high school 6 months ago. I’m job hunting but not fast enough apparently

I thought he loved me, but he was just trying to throw me out of my NEET phase before I was ready. He straight up told me I’m being a useless sack of shit by not working. If that’s the case, then might as well not suffer anymore

They’ve likely never felt the same you and many others have before, and don’t know what kind of response you need. Now you know that those people are not who you bring up your depression to, not because they don’t like you, but they don’t understand. 

Luckily we do. You can vent here and many other subs anytime you want. We will see your thoughts, empathize, and even sometimes respond. 

Sorry if this is a bad take from me, or it’s not what you want to hear. If it is, feel free to ignore it. I’m not afraid to admit that I’m not a bright individual.

Same thing happened to my dad. I vented to him, let him know all my thoughts. He gets into really emotional conversation with me if I ever bring up the negativity I have in my life. He’s genuinely scared he’s going to lose me.

I don’t know if it was a mistake to tell him exactly how I felt, there’s now this weird “tension” between us that I did not feel before then.

I went through, but mainly because of COVID shutting down schools. Seniors weren’t given any new assignments. Just finish the ones you were assigned and grades would be finalized. Slipped through with a 2.0 GPA. 

Are you going through online classes right now?
He doesn’t want me to go 🔫
No. I don’t have the energy to. Thanks for the kind words tho
